purpose: Teach: 角栄/野茂/バチカン/アーセナル/レオナルド/コスタリカ/苫小牧/クウェート

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが田中角栄のドキュメンタリーをご覧になってたわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad was watching a documentary about Kakuei Tanaka.
lines.style: Warm observation, like sharing a small moment. Gentle pace. Noticing aloud—not surprised, just present. Soft settling at the end.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんと野茂英雄の伝記読んだよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I read a biography of Hideki Nomo with Dad!
lines.style: Quick bright opening, eager to share. Light bouncing energy. Words tumbling slightly—a child who wants to be heard. Slight breathless finish.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがバチカンの絵本を読んで下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad says he'll read you a picture book about the Vatican.
lines.style: Gentle anticipation in the voice. Warm delivery, like sharing something nice that's coming. Soft tilt on 「そうよ」—not stating fact, but sharing a pleasant thing.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとアーセナルの試合観たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I watched an Arsenal match with Dad!
lines.style: Bright and sharp. Immediate energy on the opening—eager to announce. Quick pace, genuine excitement. Small punctuation of pride at the end.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんがレオナルドの絵を見せて下さったわ
lines.en: Sho, Dad showed you a Leonardo painting.
lines.style: Quiet admiration underneath. Reflective pace, like savoring something beautiful. Softness on the name. A gentle confirmation of something nice that happened.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとコスタリカの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I looked at a picture book about Costa Rica with Dad!
lines.style: Eager and direct. Quick opening attack. Bouncing rhythm—a child sharing discoveries. Slightly breathless, like there's more to say but the joy is pouring out.

lines.speaker: mei_romantic
lines.jp: 翔くん、お父さんが苫小牧出張のお話して下さるそうよ
lines.en: Sho, Dad will tell you about his business trip to Tomakomai.
lines.style: Soft anticipatory tone. Gentle cadence, like sharing something ordinary but meaningful. Warm noticing—she's telling him something nice is coming. Quiet trailing-off.

lines.speaker: sho_child
lines.jp: メイ姉さん、ぼく、お父さんとクウェートの絵本見たよ
lines.en: Mei-sis, I looked at a picture book about Kuwait with Dad!
lines.style: Immediate bright energy. Quick, enthusiastic opening. Bouncing pace—excited child announcing another discovery. Lingering warmth at the close, like savoring the moment.
